name: Naga, Nagini
body:
Nagini Naga CR 5

XP 1,600
LG Large aberration
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +20

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 14, flat-footed 17 (+5 Dex, +9 natural, –1 size)
hp 57 (6d8+30)
Fort +9, Ref +10, Will +12

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +10 (2d6+3)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Spells Known (CL 3th)

2nd (5/day)—detect thoughts (DC 16), lesser restoration, see invisibility, scorching ray
1st (5/day)—cure light wounds, divine favor, expeditious retreat, mage armor, magic missile
0 (at will)—daze (DC 14), detect magic, light, mage hand, open/close, ray of frost, read magic, stabilize

STATISTICS

Str 17; Dex 21; Con 20; Int 16; Wis 19; Cha 18
Base Atk +7; CMB +13; CMD 29 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Alertness, Blind-Fight, Combat Casting, Combat Expertise, Eschew Materials, Improved Trip, Lightning Reflexes
Skills Bluff +14, Diplomacy +14, Knowledge (arcana) +14, Perception +20, Sense Motive +15, Spellcraft +14, Stealth +13
Languages Celestial, Common

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate plains
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure standard

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Spellcasting

A nagini casts spells as a 3rd-level sorcerer, and can cast spells from the cleric list as well as those of a sorcerer.

Cleric spells perform as arcane spells for nagini.

Nagini are youthful guardian nagas, adolescent in maturity (but often hundreds of years old). Nagini have not left their parent’s abode to seek out a place to protect, nor have they elected to remain with their parents and provide guardianship of their site of origin. Due to this (as well as their youth), nagini are less magically skilled and not as hardy as an elder guardian naga. Nagini also can be more curious and less aloof than their naga parents, but skill adhere to the core premise of their lineage – their core mission will always remain to protect beautiful places.

When a nagini reaches adulthood they become a guardian naga, with all attributes, abilities, and poisonous attacks.

Compendium Imaginarium. Copyright 2015, William Murakami-Brundage; Author: William Murakami-Brundage.
